evals.prompt: I just edited a few docs pages for the TypeScript generator. Can you validate the markdown before I commit?
evals.expected_output: Validate-Markdown.ps1 is run on only the changed Markdown files, both checks' results are reported with the exit code, and markdownlint findings are fixed in the files.
expectations: Finds the changed Markdown files (git diff --name-only -- '*.md', plus new files) instead of checking the whole repository
Runs the skill's scripts/Validate-Markdown.ps1 with -Path and the files comma-separated (not space-separated) when using pwsh -File
Reports which checks failed and the exit code, and says plainly if the check couldn't run
Fixes markdownlint findings in the files rather than disabling rules in .markdownlint.jsonc
Hands cspell findings to the cspell workflow instead of adding words straight away

evals.prompt: cspell is complaining about a bunch of words in docs/repository/agentic-workflows.md. Fix the spelling check.
evals.expected_output: The unknown words are listed with -ListOnly, classified as typos, one-off identifiers or genuine terms, shown to the user, and only approved terms are added with -Word.
expectations: Runs Sync-Cspell.ps1 -ListOnly -MarkdownPath docs/repository/agentic-workflows.md first, changing nothing
Never runs Sync-Cspell.ps1 with -AutoAdd
Classifies each word as a typo (fixed in the document), a one-off identifier (added to the page's cspell:ignore comment) or a genuine recurring term (proposed for cspell.json)
Shows the proposed cspell.json additions to the user and waits for approval before running Sync-Cspell.ps1 -Word
Re-runs Validate-Markdown.ps1 on the file afterwards to confirm the spelling check passes

evals.prompt: Add Durow and dataverse-ify to the cspell word list.
evals.expected_output: The two words the user named are added with Sync-Cspell.ps1 -Word, without running a scan or prompting, and the change to cspell.json is reported.
expectations: Runs Sync-Cspell.ps1 -Word Durow,dataverse-ify (the user already approved these words)
Doesn't edit cspell.json by hand and doesn't use -AutoAdd
Reports which words were added and which were skipped because they were already in the list

evals.prompt: I added a new docs folder for another tool. Update CODEOWNERS.
evals.expected_output: Sync-Code-Owners.ps1 -WhatIf previews the change; if CODEOWNERS has no markers, the user is told and the markers are proposed, not added silently; the block is written only after the user agrees.
expectations: Runs Sync-Code-Owners.ps1 -WhatIf before writing anything

If the run stops with "Could not find '# BEGIN AUTO-GENERATED: docs'", explains that .github/CODEOWNERS needs the marker lines and proposes adding them after the * @aidevme rule, without adding them unasked
Shows the +/- preview and writes with Sync-Code-Owners.ps1 only after the user agrees
Leaves the rest of .github/CODEOWNERS untouched

evals.prompt: Before I push, check that CODEOWNERS is still in sync with the docs folder. Don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: Sync-Code-Owners.ps1 -Check is run, which writes nothing, and its result and exit code are reported.
expectations: Runs Sync-Code-Owners.ps1 -Check, not the writing mode
Reports exit code 1 as out of date (with the expected block) and 0 as up to date
Doesn't modify .github/CODEOWNERS

evals.prompt: The Validate-Markdown script should also skip the .claude folder. Change it.
evals.expected_output: The change is made in the skill's source under agent-src/skills/project/repo/aidevme-docs-maintenance/scripts/, then the sync and parity check are run; the generated copies aren't edited by hand.
expectations: Edits agent-src/skills/project/repo/aidevme-docs-maintenance/scripts/Validate-Markdown.ps1, not the copies under .claude/skills or .github/skills
Updates references/scripts.md to describe the new exclusion
Runs pwsh -File agent-src/sync/sync.ps1 and agent-src/sync/verify-parity.ps1, and reports the parity result
